Title: Anil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Anil - 30 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 61 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The ghat - stone steps, the flowing river

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Anil stands in the living room. Sonali stands near him.]

Anil: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Anil staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Anil: "Oh wow!"

[Anil and Mother clink their glasses.]

Anil (surprised): "This is amazing!"

[Anil walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Sonali: "What happened?"

[Anil waves at his sister on a video call.]

Anil: "Yes, all right."

[Anil jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Anil: "I'm ready!"

[Anil throws a bucket of water on the fire.]

Anil: "What happened?"

Scene 2: The ghat - Day

[Anil stands on the ghat. Sonali stands near him.]

Anil: "Mom, look over here."

[Anil drowns in the river.]

Sonali (laughing): "We have to be strong now."
